name: cortico-world-onepiece
description: 给 Coopanion 桌宠的航海剧情世界：119 章连载、三回合 BOSS、同伴与船坞、名刀 / 果实 / 霸气 / 图鉴，四块石碑之后还有隐藏章。整块面板是复古羊皮纸风。
author: lutsing

zh.description: 给桌宠的赏金世界：119 章连载，她一章一章往前打，打不过就自己练级。三回合 BOSS、同伴与船坞、三档名刀、十八颗果实、三种霸气、132 条图鉴，四块石碑凑齐还有一段隐藏章。羊皮纸与木牌的复古航海界面，单机、不联网、不额外调用模型。

en.description: A bounty world for your desktop pet: 119 serialized chapters she clears one at a time, three-round bosses, a crew and a six-part ship to build up, three tiers of named blades, 18 fruits, three kinds of aura, a 132-entry codex, four stone tablets and a hidden final chapter. Aged-parchment retro nautical UI. Single-player, offline, no extra model calls.
